page.overview:
Who is Baby Jiggler?

Baby Jiggler is an alternate version of The Jiggler. He inhabits a world where everyone is a baby and was featured in "The Winter King".

In appearance it is very similar to the original Jiggler but it is much smaller. He is a humanoid gray above and below, with white parts in the middle and visible holes.
